item.title: Find old versions: ProFTPD: Improper Access Control
item.description:
ProFTPD: Broken access control · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor

First step: This flaw dates from 2015, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of ProFTPD, and update or retire it.

ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2015-3306
